name: llm-preprocessor-vscode
description: Run the LLM Preprocessor as a local MCP server inside VS Code.

llmPreprocessor.binaryPath.description: Absolute path (or PATH-resolvable name) of the preprocessor_app binary.

llmPreprocessor.configPath.description: Path to config.json passed to the preprocessor. Empty = use the binary's default.

llmPreprocessor.cwd.description: Working directory for the spawned process. Empty = first workspace folder.

llmPreprocessor.serverLabel.description: Display name for the MCP server registered with VS Code.
